svg.aria-label: AI-Driven Patient Outcome Enhancement. Resource-constrained rural areas. Mar 2025. Developed an AI-based CDSS to diagnose status asthmaticus and diabetic ketoacidosis using NLP and predictive modelling, reaching 90% severity-prediction accuracy. Designed a dynamic React interface for symptom input and real-time diagnosis output. Awarded Best Paper at the Next Gen International Conference (SRM); presented at GreenCon 2025 (VIT). Accepted for publication in a Taylor & Francis journal (in press).
